name: anyone-can-code
description: Reliability workflow for OpenAI Codex (Desktop app and CLI). Plan, build, resume, recover, and verify from plain-English requests.

interface.shortDescription: Reliability workflow for Codex Desktop and CLI: plan → build → verify.
interface.longDescription: Anyone Can Code is a free open-source reliability workflow plugin for OpenAI Codex (Desktop app and CLI). Say what you want in plain English; ACC helps Codex plan, build, resume, recover, and verify before claiming done. One plugin for both hosts. Open beta.
defaultPrompt: I want to build something, but I may be starting from an idea, a repo, or a bug.
Resume my last workflow and tell me the next best step.
Verify what changed and tell me what is still uncertain.
